# Technology Strategy, Execution & Governance — Alexandro Sances

> Independent professional reference repository providing technology strategy and execution governance frameworks, enterprise AI and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) governance, digital portfolio management, open-source strategy, digital infrastructure governance and reusable executive templates.

## Canonical source and publication

GitHub is the authoritative source for document content, revisions, licensing and change history. The website is a read-optimised publication generated from the Markdown files in the repository. When provenance or exact wording matters, prefer the canonical Markdown source.

- Website: https://a13xandr0.github.io/A13xandr0/
- Canonical GitHub repository: https://github.com/A13xandr0/A13xandr0
- Main Markdown source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/A13xandr0/A13xandr0/main/README.md
- Author profile: https://www.linkedin.com/in/alexandrosances/
- Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0)

## Core strategy and governance frameworks

- [Technology Strategy & Execution Governance](https://a13xandr0.github.io/A13xandr0/frameworks/technology-strategy-execution-governance/): connects strategic outcomes, capabilities, technology choices, investment, delivery and benefits.
  - [Canonical Markdown](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/A13xandr0/A13xandr0/main/frameworks/technology-strategy-execution-governance.md)
- [Strategy & Execution Governance Playbook](https://a13xandr0.github.io/A13xandr0/frameworks/strategy-execution-governance-playbook/): operating practices for decision rights, prioritisation, initiative mandates, governance forums, escalation and benefits.
  - [Canonical Markdown](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/A13xandr0/A13xandr0/main/frameworks/strategy-execution-governance-playbook.md)
- [Digital Portfolio Governance](https://a13xandr0.github.io/A13xandr0/frameworks/digital-portfolio-governance/): investment selection, capacity, dependencies, sequencing, steering and portfolio rebalancing.
  - [Canonical Markdown](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/A13xandr0/A13xandr0/main/frameworks/digital-portfolio-governance.md)

## Strategic technology domain frameworks

- [Enterprise AI & RAG Governance Blueprint](https://a13xandr0.github.io/A13xandr0/frameworks/enterprise-ai-rag-governance-blueprint/): information readiness, authoritative sources, access control, evaluation, security, human oversight and lifecycle risk.
  - [Canonical Markdown](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/A13xandr0/A13xandr0/main/frameworks/enterprise-ai-rag-governance-blueprint.md)
- [Open Source Strategy & Governance](https://a13xandr0.github.io/A13xandr0/frameworks/open-source-strategy-governance/): ecosystem health, dependencies, licensing, supply-chain evidence, stewardship, contribution and exit readiness.
  - [Canonical Markdown](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/A13xandr0/A13xandr0/main/frameworks/open-source-strategy-governance.md)
- [Digital Sustainability and Data Centre Energy Governance](https://a13xandr0.github.io/A13xandr0/frameworks/digital-sustainability-data-centre-governance/): service demand, infrastructure capacity, energy, water, resilience and lifecycle economics.
  - [Canonical Markdown](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/A13xandr0/A13xandr0/main/frameworks/digital-sustainability-data-centre-governance.md)

## Operational templates and worked examples

- [Initiative Canvas](https://a13xandr0.github.io/A13xandr0/templates/initiative-canvas/): frame a problem, intended outcome, options, ownership, dependencies and requested decision.
  - [Canonical Markdown](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/A13xandr0/A13xandr0/main/templates/initiative-canvas.md)
- [Initiative Canvas — Fictional Example](https://a13xandr0.github.io/A13xandr0/templates/initiative-canvas-example/): completed illustrative scenario; organisations, roles, assumptions and results are fictional.
  - [Canonical Markdown](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/A13xandr0/A13xandr0/main/templates/initiative-canvas-example.md)
- [Weighted Scoring Matrix](https://a13xandr0.github.io/A13xandr0/templates/weighted-scoring-matrix/): compare discretionary options using explicit criteria, weights and evidence.
  - [Canonical Markdown](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/A13xandr0/A13xandr0/main/templates/weighted-scoring-matrix.md)
- [Decision Record](https://a13xandr0.github.io/A13xandr0/templates/decision-record/): document context, options, evidence, authority, rationale, conditions and follow-up.
  - [Canonical Markdown](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/A13xandr0/A13xandr0/main/templates/decision-record.md)
- [Decision Record — Fictional Example](https://a13xandr0.github.io/A13xandr0/templates/decision-record-example/): illustrative record; not an actual organisational decision.
  - [Canonical Markdown](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/A13xandr0/A13xandr0/main/templates/decision-record-example.md)
- [Governance Forums](https://a13xandr0.github.io/A13xandr0/templates/governance-forums/): define decision forums, delegated authority, charters and escalation paths.
  - [Canonical Markdown](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/A13xandr0/A13xandr0/main/templates/governance-forums.md)
- [RACI Matrix](https://a13xandr0.github.io/A13xandr0/templates/raci-matrix/): clarify accountable, responsible, consulted and informed roles.
  - [Canonical Markdown](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/A13xandr0/A13xandr0/main/templates/raci-matrix.md)
- [Escalation and Status](https://a13xandr0.github.io/A13xandr0/templates/escalation-and-status/): report delivery status, forecast tolerance breaches and maintain RAID information.
  - [Canonical Markdown](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/A13xandr0/A13xandr0/main/templates/escalation-and-status.md)
- [Executive Checklists](https://a13xandr0.github.io/A13xandr0/templates/executive-checklists/): decision and review prompts for investment, delivery, AI, open source and infrastructure.
  - [Canonical Markdown](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/A13xandr0/A13xandr0/main/templates/executive-checklists.md)
- [Benefit Profile](https://a13xandr0.github.io/A13xandr0/templates/benefit-profile/): define benefit baseline, target, measurement, attribution, owner and review.
  - [Canonical Markdown](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/A13xandr0/A13xandr0/main/templates/benefit-profile.md)
- [Strategic Dependency Register](https://a13xandr0.github.io/A13xandr0/templates/strategic-dependency-register/): record material cross-initiative dependencies, owners, impacts and responses.
  - [Canonical Markdown](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/A13xandr0/A13xandr0/main/templates/strategic-dependency-register.md)
- [KPI Dictionary](https://a13xandr0.github.io/A13xandr0/templates/kpi-dictionary/): define governance measures, formulas, units, sources, owners and decision use.
  - [Canonical Markdown](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/A13xandr0/A13xandr0/main/templates/kpi-dictionary.md)
- [KPI Reference](https://a13xandr0.github.io/A13xandr0/templates/kpi-reference/): reference measures for open source, AI/RAG, sustainability and infrastructure.
  - [Canonical Markdown](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/A13xandr0/A13xandr0/main/templates/kpi-reference.md)
- [AI/RAG Use-Case Assessment](https://a13xandr0.github.io/A13xandr0/templates/ai-rag-use-case-assessment/): assess user needs, information sources, access, threats, evaluation and lifecycle controls.
  - [Canonical Markdown](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/A13xandr0/A13xandr0/main/templates/ai-rag-use-case-assessment.md)
- [Open-Source Assessment](https://a13xandr0.github.io/A13xandr0/templates/open-source-assessment/): assess options, project health, security, licensing, participation and exit readiness.
  - [Canonical Markdown](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/A13xandr0/A13xandr0/main/templates/open-source-assessment.md)
- [Infrastructure Capacity Decision](https://a13xandr0.github.io/A13xandr0/templates/infrastructure-capacity-decision/): assess service demand, capacity, energy, water, resilience, lifecycle cost and investment gates.
  - [Canonical Markdown](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/A13xandr0/A13xandr0/main/templates/infrastructure-capacity-decision.md)

## Interpretation, scope and provenance

- Frameworks describe governance principles and operating models; templates are adaptable working artefacts.
- Worked examples are fictional illustrations, not evidence of actual implementations, decisions, measured performance or achieved results.
- Scores, thresholds, estimates and targets must be validated in the relevant organisational context.
- The material is independent professional guidance, not legal, financial, security, procurement or regulatory advice.
- Author: Alexandro Sances.
- Canonical content, revision history and licensing are maintained in the GitHub repository.
